source: CRON 20261014: First HoldCo Plc (FBN Holdings) consolidated and separate financial statements for the period ended 30 June 2026 (NGX doclib filing library), Group income statement, year to date 30 June 2026 column, printed in N millions and scaled to naira. The filing prints no gross earnings line, so Revenue is the sum of the printed income lines: interest income 1,398,050 plus fee and commission income 214,655 plus foreign exchange gains 44,147 plus net gains on sale of investment securities 60,624 plus net gains from financial instruments at FVTPL 65,794 plus dividend income 11,334 plus other operating income 136,673, which totals 1,931,277 million and matches the 1.93 trillion gross earnings the group reported for the half year. Operating profit, profit before tax 653,536, income tax 127,276 and profit for the period 526,130 are the printed Group figures, and profit before tax less income tax reproduces profit from continuing operations 526,260 with the 130 million loss from discontinued operations taking it to the printed 526,130. The panel has no net finance cost row for a bank, because the interest expense is already charged before the printed operating profit, so no operating profit and no net finance cost row is written for this bank. Basic earnings per share stored in naira from the printed 11.74. | NGX (doclib.ngxgroup.com) | gap filled from the audited statement: First HoldCo Plc (FBN Holdings) audited financial statements FY2025, five year financial summary GROUP page 176: profit for the year 139,483 / 677,005 / 310,370 / 136,173 / 151,079 N million and basic earnings per share 317 / 1,859 / 859 / 375 / 417 kobo, cross checked against note 50 page 171 where 132,684 N million attributable over 41,885 million weighted shares equals 3.17 naira. | CRON 20260929
